content: Ligand 1 is the best molecule found in four runs. Its numbering follows the pattern I have seen on every analogue of this scaffold: atom 1 is the amide carbonyl and atom 17 the cap ring's CH, bonded over a non-ring bond, with the azine halogen at atom 12 on carbon 11. With activity capped near 0.61 and bromine already sitting at 0.60, there is nothing left to gain on that axis - the remaining headroom is entirely in QED, and this molecule's weak point is lipophilicity at LogP 4.2, which is well past where QED starts penalising. The cap is the cheapest place to fix that: ring size measured activity-neutral four times over, so swapping the cyclopropane for an oxetane is free on activity while taking roughly a log unit off lipophilicity, for two extra daltons. The risk is SA - the oxetane consistently costs about 0.2 there, which is worth roughly 0.02 of the SA term - so this wins only if the QED gain is larger than that. Expected product: about 348 Da at LogP near 3.2.
